video_title: Chuck: Jalen Brunson is scared of NOBODY! + Wemby is NOT aggressive 👀 | Inside The NBA

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's fearless playmaking is key to the Knicks' success
quotes.excerpt: That Brunson kid ain't scared of nobody!
quotes.quote: That Brunson kid ain't scared of nobody. I'm going to score on anybody. He has that tremendous confidence.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama must be forced away from the basket
quotes.excerpt: The only way I think you can beat the Spurs is you got to get Victor away
quotes.quote: The only way I think you can beat the Spurs is you got to get Victor away from the basket, because if you let him stand back there and play safety, it's going to be tough. I would put Brunson and whoever in the pick and roll every single time to get that big boy away from the basket.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Debate over whether Victor Wembanyama is an aggressive player

text_blocks.speaker: Charles Barkley
text_blocks.text: One of your biggest problems is, as much as I love you, you always put your brain in other people. Everybody's not aggressive.

text_blocks.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
text_blocks.text: When he played aggressive last series, he had 42 points. He did, one game. He also had 21 in Game 7. He ain't like you.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's lack of natural aggression on the court
quotes.quote: He's not an aggressive player. You can't assume. Shaq is an aggressive person. Victor, he's a nice kid. He can be aggressive at times, but he don't get to the gym and say, 'I'm going to take everybody's lunch money every day.' He needs to get going and going and going.
